sentences.text: This is second application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No.152/2023 registered at Police Station Malhargarh, Distt. Mandsaur (M.P.) under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sec.5(1)/6, 5(J)(ii)(l)/6 of POCSO Act.
The first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to revive after the cross examination of prosecution witnesses in support of scholar register.

Counsel for applicant submits that the statement of prosecutrix has been recorded and as per the statement she has gone on motor cycle along with the applicant to Chittorgarh and from Chittorgarh to Singroli, Maharashtra in train.
She stayed with the applicant for one month and married.
She made physical relationship and also got pregnant.

It is argued that as per the statement of prosecutrix she was consenting and as per aadhar card she was more than m18 years on the date of marriage.
Counsel for State opposed the prayer, however, he could not point out 2 MCRC-22788-2024 any scholar register in regard to date of birth.

After hearing learned counsel for parties and taking into consideration the statement of the prosecutrix and the fact that prosecution could not show the date of birth as per scholar register, as per aadhar card the prosecutrix is major on the dade of marriage, prima facie case is made out for grant of bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is further made clear that if it is found that the applicant is involved in any other case during the trial, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without reference to the Court and the Police will be at liberty to arrest the applicant.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
